summary: The home page of a state-commissioned free typeface (Wayback snapshot): a fullPage.js deck of four full-screen sections, a black wordmark hero with a credits-and-download strip, then one section per style (Roman + ligatures, Italic, Bold + pictograms), each a horizontal carousel of 12–15 SVG specimen slides alternating white, blue and black. Project, story, studies, tester and info live on separate pages that were not captured.

instances.look: Full black screen with 'INFINI' in white caps at ~240px, its flared, chiselled strokes the only ornament; beneath it a white-outlined strip split into 'A TYPEFACE CREATED BY SANDRINE NUGUE' | 'A PUBLIC COMMISSION BY THE CENTRE NATIONAL DES ARTS PLASTIQUES (FR)' | a solid white 'DOWNLOAD' cell; a ↓ arrow at the bottom
instances.ux: Download cell fetches the zip; the arrow or wheel snaps to the next full-screen section
instances.learn: Fold credits and the download into one ruled strip under the wordmark: it reads like a museum label and a button at once

reconstruction.layout: 100vh black section; wordmark centred at y≈260–510, ~920px wide; credit strip 940×76px centred at y≈570 with a 2px white border, three cells (~310 / ~380 / ~235px), the last filled white; ↓ at bottom centre
reconstruction.typography: Wordmark ~240px Infini Roman caps, white; strip labels ~13px Infini caps white, two lines; DOWNLOAD ~14px caps black on white
reconstruction.behaviour: fullPage.js: wheel or arrow snaps to the next section with a vertical slide; dot nav at right marks the active section

instances.look: Two 'DOWNLOAD' buttons: a grey block at the right end of the nav and the white cell in the hero strip
instances.ux: Both download a zip with the fonts and a PDF specimen (Creative Commons licence, explained on the Info page)
instances.learn: Keep the free download in the nav on every screen and repeat it in the hero

reconstruction.layout: Nav button ~150×50px at the far right of the 50px bar; hero cell ~235×76px

instances.look: Three full-screen sections, one per style, each with a thin electric-blue label bar ('INFINI ROMAN + LIGATURES', 'INFINI ITALIC', 'INFINI BOLD + PICTOGRAMS') and a title slide: 'Infini Roman + LIGATURES' / 'Bristly in display sizes, supple for text', 'Infini italic' / 'Faithful partner for the roman, yet independent', 'Infini bold + PICTOS' (with a snake pictogram) / 'Oversized to overshadow its neighbors', large black type with a blue tagline; ← → arrows at the screen edges
instances.ux: Wheel moves between style sections; side arrows (or swipe) page horizontally through 15 Roman, 12 Italic and 13 Bold specimen slides whose backgrounds alternate white, blue and black (only the title slides were captured)
instances.learn: Give each style its own horizontal slide deck under a one-line characterisation: the visitor chooses depth per style instead of scrolling one long specimen

reconstruction.layout: Each section 100vh; 30px blue label bar at the top with the style name at x≈250; slide content centred (~1100px); arrows 30px at x≈60 and x≈1360, vertically centred; fp-nav dots at the right edge
reconstruction.typography: Title ~110px Infini (Roman, Italic or Bold) black, second line in caps with the special ligatures (LI, GA, TU, RE); tagline ~44px in the same style, blue #1010c8; label bar ~11px caps white
reconstruction.behaviour: fullPage.js vertical sections with horizontal fp-slides; control arrows .fp-prev/.fp-next; slide classes .blue/.black switch the background
reconstruction.content: One-line characterisations per style; further slides are specimen 'friezes' (eng-frise-roman-01…15.svg)

instances.look: Four small outlined dots fixed at the right edge, the current section's dot filled (white on the black hero, black on the white slides)
instances.ux: Marks which of the four full-screen sections is active; clicking a dot jumps there
instances.learn: A dot column is all a snap-scrolling deck needs for orientation

reconstruction.layout: Fixed at right ~14px from the edge, vertically centred, 4 dots ~8px with ~12px gaps
reconstruction.behaviour: fullPage.js #fp-nav: active class follows the section

instances.look: Dark grey 50px top bar on the hero: round 'GF' (Graphisme en France) logo at left, tabs INFINI (active, black) / The project / The story / Studies / Try it / Info linking to separate pages, an 'FR' badge and a grey DOWNLOAD block at right
